setting: walking down the hill from the hospital at twenty past eight on the first properly light morning of the year, boots on grit, a gate closing somewhere behind him, a long pause where he stops dead as something goes over the road and then carries on without explaining it, gulls and a distant bus at the end

her kitchen late on a Sunday morning, water running and being turned off twice, plates set down on a draining board, four notes hummed under her breath in a gap between sentences without her noticing, the radiator ticking and her voice easy and unhurried for once

the walk home after the fourth night in a row, steps slightly uneven, breath close on the microphone, two long silences and one of eleven seconds where a gate shuts and he says nothing, the last sentence about an oven begun and then abandoned

the back seat of a bus on a Sunday afternoon, engine drone and the ping of the bell twice, her voice low so the other passengers cannot hear, the word ordinary used four times, a laugh cut short when someone sits down in front of her

the bottom of the hill at half past eight on a bright cold late March morning, birds loud and constant behind everything, his footsteps slowing near the end, one sentence about a plant on a windowsill said in a flat voice that gives it away, traffic building at the junction
